prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for every implant case. **A strong Dallas option to consult is Dr. David McFadden at The Dental Implant Center**: the practice identifies him as a board-certified prosthodontist and says it handles both implant placement and restoration, including complex cases. It’s at **5120 W. Lovers Lane**; **(214) 956-9100**. [Practice details](https://www.dentalimplantcenter.com/our-practice/)

For a second opinion—especially if you have gum disease, need bone grafting, or have a complex surgical case—consider a **board-certified periodontist**, such as **Dr. Laura N. Rabe** at Dallas Periodontics and Dental Implants. [Practice details](https://www.periodallas.com/)

Before choosing, get a written treatment plan and total cost, ask who places the implant and who makes the crown, and confirm the clinician’s specialty-board credentials. A consultation and your imaging are needed to determine who’s the best fit for *your* case.
